requirements.title: C descriptors are initialized, updated, or copied only by specified CFI functions
requirements.source: S18.6 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF543.
requirements.definition: A C descriptor shall not be initialized, updated, or copied except by calling the functions specified in 18.5.5.

pending.c-descriptor-managed-only-by-cfi-functio: No portable diagnostic is required for the unnumbered program obligation. A future positive mixed C plan establishes a descriptor through CFI_establish, updates allocation only through CFI_allocate or CFI_deallocate, passes it to Fortran, and observes the described object rather than any manual CFI_cdesc_t copy.

requirements.title: Certain corresponding C descriptors are not modified through formal parameters
requirements.source: S18.6 p2.descriptor-not-modified; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF543.
requirements.definition: A C descriptor formal parameter corresponding to a Fortran actual argument or to a C actual argument for a Fortran dummy shall not be modified for an INTENT(IN) dummy or for a nonallocatable nonpointer object.

pending.intent-in-corresponding-descriptor-not-m: No portable diagnostic or runtime oracle is required for this unnumbered C-program obligation; a C function that merely refrains from descriptor modification is a vacuous observation of the rule. Non-credited descriptor-context control after guarding C_FLOAT > 0 before any C_FLOAT-kind declaration: Fortran calls a BIND(C) C function with assumed-shape dummy real(c_float) :: a(:,:) using actual x(10:11,-1:1) containing column-major values 1.25, 2.25, 3.25, 4.25, 5.25, 6.25. C receives a CFI_cdesc_t*, checks rank == 2, type == CFI_type_float, attribute == CFI_attribute_other, elem_len == sizeof(float), extents 2 and 3, lower_bound values 0 and 0 per 18.5.3 p3 for a nonallocatable nonpointer object, and reads those six values with CFI_address subscripts (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1), (0,2), and (1,2). An assumed-rank analogue uses real(c_float) :: a(..) and checks the same descriptor facts after confirming rank == 2.
pending.nonallocatable-nonpointer-descriptor-not: No portable diagnostic or runtime oracle is required for this unnumbered C-program obligation; preserving a nonallocatable nonpointer descriptor snapshot only proves that the test C code was well behaved. The descriptor-context control is the same non-credited assumed-shape and assumed-rank CFI_cdesc_t plan: guarded C_FLOAT kind, actual x(10:11,-1:1), extents 2 by 3, lower_bound values 0 and 0 from 18.5.3 p3, attribute CFI_attribute_other, elem_len sizeof(float), type CFI_type_float, and column-major values 1.25, 2.25, 3.25, 4.25, 5.25, 6.25 read via CFI_address.

requirements.title: POINTER INTENT(OUT) descriptor base_addr is not accessed before receiving a value
requirements.source: S18.6 p2.base-addr-before-value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF543.
requirements.definition: For a C descriptor corresponding to a POINTER dummy with INTENT(OUT), base_addr shall not be accessed before it is given a value.

pending.pointer-intent-out-base-addr-not-read-be: No portable diagnostic or runtime oracle exists for the forbidden early access. A future conforming mixed C plan first gives base_addr a value through the registered CFI route, then reads through the established target and checks a nonzero sentinel.

requirements.title: Assumed-shape dummy descriptors are not assumed-size descriptors
requirements.source: S18.6 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF543.
requirements.definition: A C descriptor passed as a C actual argument corresponding to an assumed-shape Fortran dummy shall not describe an assumed-size array.

pending.assumed-shape-correspondence-excludes-as: No portable diagnostic is required for this unnumbered C descriptor obligation. Positive descriptor plan after guarding C_FLOAT > 0 before any C_FLOAT-kind declaration: a C caller passes a C descriptor for a rank-two real(c_float) object to a BIND(C) Fortran procedure with assumed-shape dummy real(c_float) :: a(:,:); the descriptor has rank 2, extents 2 and 3, lower_bound values 0 and 0 for the nonallocatable nonpointer object as specified by 18.5.3 p3, and neither extent equals -1, so it is not an assumed-size descriptor. The hand-derived element order is (10,-1)=1.25, (11,-1)=2.25, (10,0)=3.25, (11,0)=4.25, (10,1)=5.25, (11,1)=6.25 for the Fortran actual x(10:11,-1:1); an assumed-rank companion real(c_float) :: a(..) first confirms rank 2 and then uses the same extent and CFI_address value checks.

review_rationale: Source registration for 18.6-18.10.4: restrictions on C descriptors and lifetimes, interoperation with C global variables and binding labels, and interoperation with C functions (batch245). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; cross-language calls, descriptors and binding labels are planned as mixed Fortran/C programs with exact results, and program-side restrictions carry no oracle. C1807 had no existing tests. Source accounting only.
